name: Jiminny
tagline: Jiminny is a sales intelligence platform that records, transcribes, and analyzes sales calls and video meetings with AI. It provides automated coaching feedback, deal risk alerts, and CRM auto-updates to help sales managers develop their teams and improve win rates.
